patterns.note: Full-width content sections are used, with internal elements consistently centered horizontally, creating clear visual blocks.
A clean sans-serif typeface is used for both headings and body text, with headings employing a slightly bolder weight and moderate size increase for hierarchy.
The primary brand color, a vibrant teal, is strategically used for the hero background and main call-to-action buttons, providing a strong focal point against predominantly white content sections.
A persistent header navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, providing continuous access to site navigation.
Content is segmented into distinct horizontal bands, with visual separation achieved through alternating background colors (teal for hero, white for content) and generous vertical padding.

technique_notes: The page employs a fixed-position header that maintains its visibility at the top of the screen, ensuring navigation is always accessible.
Content is organized into full-width sections, with all internal elements centered horizontally to create a balanced and structured layout.
Call-to-action buttons feature a solid background color in the brand's primary hue, with subtle rounded corners for a soft, approachable feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are moderately larger than body text, using a slightly bolder weight for emphasis, while body text is clean and legible.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and search inputs, otherwise sharp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced vertical spacing between major sections, with a slightly more airy feel in the hero area, and a tighter grid for logo displays.

standout: The site's design is distinctive in its straightforward, no-frills presentation of a vast data resource. It avoids common modern animation trends, instead relying on clear sectioning and a consistent brand color to guide the user through information, making it feel highly functional and trustworthy.
